channel.title: Hench & Scrap - Props & Cosplay
channel.description:
We're Hench and Scrap, Aussie nerds who make stuff from video games!

In 2016, two nerds met at PAX Australia. Both in Overwatch cosplay – Hench as Mei and Scrap as Reinhardt – they bonded over their shared love of ridiculously accurate video game cosplay and props. That day, the seed of Hench and Scrap was sewn.

Hench and Scrap was born from our shared love of obsessive dedication to silly level

videos.t: Crash Bandicoot 4 - building the Quantum Masks
videos.desc: To celebrate the launch of Crash Bandicoot 4, we created a set of Quantum Masks! They, alongside 5 huge Wumpa fruit we also created, were used in a promo video in which Crash crashed the Australia Zoo!

videos.t: Hench & Scrap Foundry - Starcraft Anniversary Zealot Psi-blades
videos.desc: For the Starcraft Anniversary, we were tasked to produce a short run of Starcraft Zealot Psi-blades for giveaways and display in Blizzard offices around the globe. This was our first project together as Hench & Scrap Foundry!

videos.t: Hench & Scrap build the Shadowlands - Part 1, Kyrian Mace
videos.desc: We've been working in collaboration with Blizzard on a series of prop builds as part of the lead up to the release of the upcoming Shadowlands expansion for World of Warcraft! First up, we're beyond thrilled to reveal the first of our four props, the Kyrian two-handed mace!

videos.t: Hench & Scrap build the Shadowlands - Part 2, Necrolords Staff
videos.desc: Part 2 of our World of Warcraft: Shadowlands collaboration with Blizzard ANZ, where we selected a prop to build from each of the four covenants of the Shadowlands! Today we show you how we built this enormous Necrolords staff, complete with smoke, lighting, and a spinning crystal!

videos.t: Hench & Scrap build the Shadowlands - Part 3, Venthyr sword and shield
videos.desc: Part 3 of our World of Warcraft: Shadowlands collaboration with Blizzard ANZ, where we selected a prop to build from each of the four covenants of the Shadowlands! Today we show you how we built not one, but two props this time - a shield with a churning anima tank, and a glowing sword!

videos.t: Hench & Scrap build the Shadowlands - Part 4, Night Fae Bow
videos.desc: Part 4 of our World of Warcraft: Shadowlands collaboration with Blizzard ANZ, where we selected a prop to build from each of the four covenants of the Shadowlands! We wrap up our Covenants weapon build series with this beautiful bioluminescent Night Fae bow! Collaborating with Blizzard on this has been an incredible experience – we are both SO HYPED for Shadowlands!

videos.t: Making of: Ask an Old God (Hearthstone)
videos.desc:
In a pact with the Old Gods, we created the board for Blizzard ANZ's Ask An Old God online event! Here's how we did it!
Unrelated; anyone know how to stop your workshop whispering to you?

videos.t: We built a life size Sentinel Hammer from DOOM Eternal: The Ancient Gods - Part Two!
videos.desc:
For the launch of DOOM Eternal: The Ancient Gods - Part Two, we teamed up with Bethesda ANZ to construct a life-size version of the Sentinel Hammer.

Incorporating 3D printing, an aluminium handle & lighting, the prop measures 1.4 metres high/0.63 metres wide!

videos.t: We made Illidan's Warglaives for Blizzard!
videos.desc:
So, we've spent the past month building these utterly insane Twin Blades of Azzinoth from World of Warcraft for Blizzard ANZ to celebrate the upcoming release of Burning Crusade Classic!

Some fun facts:
- They’re taller than Hench (they’re 1.8m/5’9” long!)
- Each blade had a galaxy projector built into it, which gives them that rippling fel energy effect!
- They’re hand gilded in real 24kt gold, and it took 140 sheets to gild everything
- We made an enormous blade mold and slush cast them in translucent resin

We hope you enjoy watching our build processes, and if you'd like to see more video

videos.t: Making a FUNCTIONAL Trebuchet Trophy for Red Bull Wololo V!
videos.desc:
We built the trophy for this year's Red Bull Gaming Wololo V!
When you get a brief that asks "Can you build us a working trebuchet, but make it a trophy?", you don't say no!
It was a whirlwind build that took a whole lot of print time, and ended in this 3D printed, aluminium reinforced beast of a trophy that stands almost a metre tall fully deployed. The trebuchet itself is made of solid oak, and features an almost one kilo resin counterweight!

videos.t: We made a Tyrael cosplay!
videos.desc:
We reveled in the opportunity to turn Oarin into Tyrael, celebrating the release of Diablo II: Resurrected in our collaboration with Blizzard!

It was an absolute honor to be trusted with bringing such an iconic character to life, and this proved to be one of the biggest and most ambitious builds we've ever done, with a staggering amount of armor to produce and fit. Watch the video to see how justice was delivered from the Hench & Scrap workshop! We were so thankful to enlist Steamkittens as videographer for our beautiful cathedral video shoot, too!

videos.t: Making Skyrim's Mace of Molag Bal for Bethesda
videos.desc:
We're really proud of this one! To celebrate the launch of Skyrim Anniversary Edition, Bethesda tasked us with creating a replica of the Mace of Molag Bal!
This was a dream project, and we're pretty thrilled to be a part of Skyrim's 10th anniversary celebrations. Happy birthday, Skyrim!

videos.t: Crafting Skyrim's Sanguine Rose for Bethesda
videos.desc: For Bethesda ANZ's Bethesda Holiday Special, we were asked to bring the Sanguine Rose - one of the more iconic staves from Skyrim - to life, in meticulous detail! Here's how we did it ...

videos.t: Hench & Scrap Foundry 2021 retrospective
videos.desc:
Here's a heartfelt little video of the year's big projects.

At the end of of 2020, we didn't know if our pandemic-ravaged business would survive. Then 2021 came - our busiest and biggest year to date.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for believing in the both of us!

videos.t: We cosplayed the Lich King for Blizzard!
videos.desc: In celebration of the release of Wrath of the Lich King classic, Blizzard gave us the once in a lifetime opportunity to build a full Lich King cosplay, complete with Frostmourne and the Helm of Domination. We couldn't be prouder. Check out our making of video!

videos.t: We Made The Lich King for Blizzard (Highlights)
videos.desc:
It's been an incredible past couple of months for us as we painstakingly brought the Lich King to life for @blizzard_anz as part of the Wrath of the Lich King launch. Opportunities to work on projects like this - such an iconic character from our all-time favourite game - are a once in a lifetime thing, and we feel pretty honoured to have been able to do this. 
To see more of how we made this, check out our Making Of video, posted on our channel a few days back!


#wrathclassic #lichking #wotlk #wrathofthelichking #3dprintprops #frostmourne #cosplay #wowcosplay #blizzardcosplay #cosplayarmor #

videos.t: Bringing Dragonflight's Whelplings to life!
videos.desc:
We're pretty thrilled to finally reveal this heartwarming collab with @Blizzard  celebrating the release of World of Warcraft Patch 10.1! This project is by far the most adorable, ambitious and technically challenging project we have ever done, and we used over 30 kilos of silicone across the entire build! We are very proud of how beautiful they turned out and how much life they have, and we hope they grow up big and strong! They love scritches on the head and bellies full of sandwiches. 

#worldofwarcraft  #dragonflight #cosplay #moldmaking #puppetry #blizzardcosplay #puppet #3dprintprops #co

videos.t: Making an ESO Breton Chest cooler!
videos.desc:
Last year we made not one, but twenty five of these Breton chest coolers for Bethesda ANZ! Check out how we made them ...
Big thanks to Piltover city customs for coming onboard to assist us in making the remaining 24 after the first one.

videos.t: We made a light up Balrog statue with infinity mirror for WOTC!
videos.desc: For MTGxLOTR we created a huge, one meter long diorama of the infamous scene where Gandalf faces down the Balrog. Featuring an infinity mirror in the chasm and a huge array of custom lighting, this was used as a promotional giveaway by Wizards of the Coast.

videos.desc:
Earlier this year WOTC approached us to make a huge (50 cm!) tall statue of our favorite monster mommy from Phyrexia, so we spent a few weeks meticulously bringing her to life in gorgeous detail.
We had a tonne of fun - modelling was by Scrap and paint work by Hench.

We put so much love and care into this project and we're so satisfied with the result. See how we modelled, 3D printed and finished these gorgeous props ...

videos.desc: If you've followed our updates across social the past few months, you'll have seen our progress on bringing Admiral Brass to life for WOTC, based on the gorgeous #mtgixalan card art by Jason Rainville. Here's how it all came together ...

videos.t: We brought Bloomburrow's Mabel to life as a puppet!
videos.desc:
Bloomburrow has officially released, so it's time for us to show you the finished result of our Mabel Puppet, built in collaboration with Magic the Gathering! We're so delighted with how she turned out. Scrap's mum says an acronym for Mabel is "Mothers always bring extra love" and we've been quoting that to each other constantly as we make all her little bits and pieces. This short video barely scratches the surface of all the little details and techniques we used on this one, so we'll be posting some shorts on our channel that go into a bit more depth with certain processes. 

Also a shoutout

videos.t: The Sanguine Rose - Skyrim staff made for Bethesda
Bringing Loot to life, as a puppet!
videos.desc:
We've been working on a puppet build for Wizards of the Coast for a few weeks now, and now that MTG Foundations is out and the Summer Of Magic has kicked off, it's time for Loot! Please enjoy 90 seconds of us bringing MTG's sweet scrungly little child to life in our cosy little workshop.

#magicthegathering #mtgfoundations #puppetmaking

videos.t: DOOM: The Dark Ages Shield Saw #doom #doomthedarkages #bethesda #developerdirect
videos.desc:
How about all that DOOM: Dark Ages stuff at Xbox Developer Direct? 👀
So, we are pretty thrilled to be able to reveal the shield saw (and flail) that we made for Bethesda ANZ! Those of you who were at PAX Aus might have had a sneaky preview of them and maybe even been able to personally hoist the hefty mass of steel, aluminium, plastic and rubber that makes up the DOOM Slayers arsenal!
Featuring an enormous planetary gear mech designed by Scrap, and paint work by Hench!
We are both BEYOND excited for DOOM: The Dark Ages!

videos.t: We made a Va'Ruun Helmet from Starfield for Bethesda
videos.desc:
We're still pretty enamored with the House Va'ruun helmet we made last year for Bethesda. We ended up making two of these, and they were used as giveaways by the Bethesda ANZ team!
Still really stoked at how nicely this project turned out, especially for a 10 day build. We're both very fond of the Starfield aesthetic!

videos.t: Warframe x Hench & Scrap at TennoCon 2025
videos.desc:
WE ARE SO EXCITED FOR OUR NEXT PROJECT!! We’re going to be spending the next few weeks in our shop making a LIFE SIZE two-person operated puppet of the Krubie from @Warframe! We both absolutely adore the Duviri Aesthetic, so we were delighted when Digital Extremes asked us to bring this massive good boy to life. The best part is we’ll be unveiling it LIVE in London, Ontario on July 18th/19th at TennoCon 2025!! AHHHH!!

If you’ve never played Warframe before, the brief summary is that it’s a free to play, third-person action shooter that can be played solo or with up to three friends in online

videos.t: We're making a Krubie from Warframe!
videos.desc:
Starting off our @PlayWarframe puppet journey to TennoCon 2025 with a material breakdown. Every project starts this way, going through a design and figuring out what materials are going to be best for each segment, weighing up the pros and cons for weight, durability, flex, cost etc. It's a lot of decision making and sourcing! For our smaller puppet rigs we'd be inclined to do a lot of this in sillicone, but at the quite significant size of the Krubie the weight would rapidly spiral out of control. Foamed sillicone backfilling really only goes so far, so instead this is our plan! 


Use the li

videos.t: DOOM: The Dark Ages Skull Crusher IRL at Slayer Scale
videos.desc:
We promised to show you more of our Skull Crusher (Pulverizer) build from @DOOM The Dark Ages, so here are some juicy close ups!  Some fun facts about this project ...

- While the game model was provided by Bethesda, I still needed to do weeks and weeks of 3D modelling work and interface design to turn it into a functioning object for print and assembly.
- We ended up with 324 individual pieces overall. That's a lot of assembly work for just two people!
- The chains are real stainless steel roller chain we sourced from an engineering supplier.
- There's over 20 different profiles and lengths

videos.t: How we made our cable controlled Warframe Krubie puppet head for TennoCon!
videos.desc:
Continuing our @PlayWarframe puppet journey to TennoCon 2025, we've added all of the mechs to our big ol' Krubie head! With the addition of a few basic movements, you can get a lot of life and personality from a puppet project! We'll be casting the ears in silicone shortly, but for now there's a rigid printed pair in place to show you how they work. Our Krubie is starting to come to life!

#Warframe #TennoCon #sponsored

videos.t: 3D Printing our Krubie Puppet tail for TennoCon
videos.desc:
Next up on our @PlayWarframe puppet project for TennoCon 2025, we made the tail! Duviri's goodest boi has a HUGE tail - it's about a meter long!
We opted to print it in TPU for crowd safety & maximum bouncy tail wags.

A lot of people were asking how we got our TPU prints so smooth when we last showed one of these tail pieces - truly, they're just printed on our @elegoo Centauri Carbon in Overture TPU, using the default slicer settings and tree supports.

We're getting there! Over the next week we have a whole lot of molding and casting to do, as we've slowly been printing and post processing

videos.t: Flex Foam casting Krubie puppet legs!
videos.desc:
Duviri's goodest boi gets bouncy, bouncy legs in the next part of our @playwarframe puppet project!

We spent a lot of time making molds for all of the flexible pieces and casting them in flexible foam!

Products we used to make our mold were:
Rebound 25 brush-on silicone
EpoxAcoat red
Epoxamite 101
Flex foam-it X
All by @smoothon

Our Krubie is really starting to take shape now! We're still so sad we won't be taking this project to TennoCon, but we can't wait to watch all the action from home - and we can't wait to show you our Krubie puppet, too!

Use the link in our bio to play Warframe for

videos.t: Warframe Puppet - Krubie teaser
videos.desc:
TennoCon is just around the corner, which means we're getting extremely close to unveiling our Krubie AKA @PlayWarframe's goodest boi. I promise when he's not lurking in the darkness that he's actually adorable.

While we wish we could be there in person with you, we'd love it if those of you attending could go check out the incredible stuff @PlexiCosplay and @Hoku Props have brought along! Bonus points if you bring them Tim Tams for us and keep the aussie spirit alive ❤

#Warframe #TennoCon #sponsored

videos.t: Painting a Warframe Krubie
videos.desc:
Paint is really where our @PlayWarframe Krubie has turned from a pile of parts to a real life, living, breathing doggo! Paint on any project is also where I get the double delight of watching Hench in her element! 

We're still so sad we won't be at TennoCon in person, but we're so keen to watch all the action from home - are you going to tune in too?

All the flexible foam sections of our Krubie were painted in @smoothon MakerPro paints, with a flexibilizer, so they'll stand up to all the heavy duty movement the puppet demands (Especially the legs!). I'm also obsessed the the beetle like meta

videos.t: Krubie Puppet Inner Workings
videos.desc:
Please enjoy a brief interlude of me waffling about the internals of our Krubie puppet while we've got it apart for rigging (In between watching TennoCon!) We're very excited to show you the rest soon.

 I really enjoy this type of hand rig that uses pneumatic couplings and PTFE for running all the control lines - They're cheap and readily available because they're used in 3D printers. Accessible parts like that are great, next time I want to experiment with guitar tuning pegs for easy tension adjustment.

videos.desc:

We always love watching the TennoCon cosplay competition for a few reasons; the beautiful art style of @PlayWarframe is definitely a big one, but also the fact that it's a top prize of $10k CAD, with additional prizes for runners-up (Maybe you should enter next year!), so the competitive nature definitely makes it one of the highlights of the annual cosplay competition calendar.

videos.t: We made a life-size Krubie Puppet!
videos.desc:
It's TIME FOR THE REVEAL!! We're so, so excited to finally show you our full size Krubie puppet from @PlayWarframe, in all its ridiculous splendour! We're immensely proud of this build, it was such a massive project to tackle and we're thrilled at how we kept to a high degree of finish and mobility despite the size! We're still so sad that life got in the way of being able to take this enormous build to TennoCon, but holy heck are we proud of what we've achieved! This is the most complex project we've ever undertaken!

We especially wanted to thank Digital Extremes from the bottom of our heart

videos.desc:
It's been an incredible journey creating our huge life size Krubie puppet for @playwarframe. Since we didn't get to take it to TennoCon this year, it was brilliant to pull together a team to do some location photography outside in the atmospheric rain!

We can't thank all of you enough for your morale support through all the trials and tribulations that happened across the project, and for all the lovely comments and messages along the way. The Warframe community truly is incredible.

videos.t: Destiny 2: Gryphon Combat Sparrow mini's
videos.desc:
At heart I'm a spaceship guy, and there's something deeply satisfying about assembling a great model kit. Doubly so when it has a cool terrain set-piece! So, when it came to making a trio of Gryphon Combat Sparrows earlier this year for Destiny 2 I knew exactly how I wanted to approach it. 


Most of the work here was breaking everything down like an old-school model kit, I spent a lot of time taking all the lovely little trims and details into seperate pieces with little mounting points and rod channels. It was worth it, because we could have a beautiful little knolled Sparrow that Hench coul

videos.t: We made World of Warcraft Player Housing IRL
videos.desc:
We’re both a little (ahaha no, a LOT) obsessed with the new WoW player housing, so I bugged Scrap to help me make this little World of Warcraft project until he caved. Now we have a sweet Suramar window that we’ll be able to hang in our new house when we move in, which is SOON! We’re feeling a bit Night Elfy when it comes to our taste in decor (Millennial beige, no. Kaldorei Moonberry Amethyst, yes).

We couldn’t have done this project without the two neat tools Creality sent us - the @creality K2 Plus printer, which a lot of these huge pieces fill the whole height of (the build volume is 350x

videos.t: POV: You French cleat your entire life
Turns out we've made a LOT of stufffor Blizzard!
videos.desc:
It's #blizzcon time, so that's got us reflecting on all the myriad of things we've made over the years for Blizzard!
We've come a LONG way since we worked (before we were even a couple!) together on the Overwatch World Cup. After that, we made a big batch of StarCraft protoss psi-blades in Scrap's mum's basement to celebrate StarCraft's 15th anniversary. videos.desc:
It's been so hard to keep this under wraps - You'll be seeing us all weekend at the Blizzard ANZ booth at PAX! More importantly, we want to see you there too - cosplays, gamers, WoW fans, everyone! Let's make this a PAXAUS we'll remember ... forever! (We're not sorry, the terrible puns will be present too) 
World of Warcraft: Forever releases on November 5! If you'd like to hear more check out the link in our bio! 
#Ad #WoWForever #Blizzard
